Our services

Every package is built to the same standard — no shortcuts, no rushed jobs. Pick what your car needs and we'll bring the shine to your driveway.

Our commitment

Extreme care, every single vehicle

Extreme Car Detailz was founded out of a passion for cars and a desire to provide unparalleled detailing services. Based in Perth, we're committed to giving each vehicle the care and attention it deserves, transforming them into works of art.
